project.name: owen_county
project.description: Owen County Project Digital Twin bring-online shell. Companion to UK CAER under the Devere/TCS Project Digital Twin standard. Domain graph captures the five real business domains: Project Shell & Doctrine, Source Currentness, Live Overlay (OneDrive/TCS_OVERLAY), PM Twin Configuration, and Bring-Online Work Orders.

nodes.name: Project Shell & Doctrine
nodes.summary: Top-level Level 1 Twin Shell identity, the non-inheritance rule (no UK CAER fact leakage), the six-rank authority stack, and the Altitude Mesh Operating System doctrine the Owen County twin runs on.

nodes.name: Source Currentness
nodes.summary: Source registration plus the explicit gap-list (missing executed contract, live Sage, live Submittal Exchange, live Outlook, live OneDrive re-inventory, current May 2026 status) that drives all source-currentness work orders.

nodes.name: Live Overlay (OneDrive / TCS_OVERLAY)
nodes.summary: The live OneDrive project folder pointer ('/Users/michael/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-DevereConstruction/03 Running Projects/2025/6. Owen Co Schools Upgrades & Athletics') and the TCS_OVERLAY snapshot (cleanpoints, master spine, Sage CM snapshot). Confirmed present but not yet re-inventoried by Level 1 shell.

nodes.name: PM Twin Configuration
nodes.summary: Twin object families (Project, ProjectGate, ProjectTwinState, Zone, EvidenceToken, ApprovalBoundary, ActionRecord, RiskRecord), the OWEN-VQ-001..009 validation queue, the A0-D2 gate matrix, validation-state taxonomy, and the receipt template required for any gate movement.

nodes.name: Bring-Online Work Orders
nodes.summary: The Next Safe Load Sequence that takes the Level 1 review-only shell to Level 2 operational twin: verify live path, read latest cleanpoint, inventory original controls, pull read-only exports from Sage/Submittal Exchange/Outlook, then build first slices for contract/gate, Sage/commercial, schedule, procurement, safety, quality, RFIs/submittals, and PM rhythm.

nodes.name: Doctrine Boot Flow
nodes.summary: The ordered read-and-bind path an agent follows to register Owen County identity and bind to the Altitude Mesh operating system before any other work is permitted.

nodes.name: Source Currentness Verification Flow
nodes.summary: The flow that turns SOURCE_MAP.md's Missing Source Evidence list into a current, validated source-of-record map across all eight lanes (contract, Sage, submittals, RFIs, schedule, safety/QC, correspondence, PM actions).

nodes.name: Live Overlay Rehydration Flow
nodes.summary: The flow that re-inventories the live OneDrive folder (folders 1-18 plus Issues, HERMES_INBOX, TCS_OVERLAY), refreshes cleanpoints, and reconciles the TCS_OVERLAY snapshot against the live originals so the twin operates on May 2026 reality, not April packet seed.

nodes.name: PM Twin Configuration Flow
nodes.summary: The flow that loads dated evidence tokens against each twin object family, drives the OWEN-VQ-001..009 validation queue from disputed seed to validated/disputed/superseded, and posts gate movement receipts under the A0-D2 matrix.

nodes.name: Bring-Online Sequence Flow
nodes.summary: The six-step Next Safe Load Sequence from TWIN_STATE.md that promotes the Owen County twin from Level 1 review-only shell to Level 2 operational twin with first slices across all required lanes.

nodes.name: Read AGENT_BOOT.md and register project identity
nodes.summary: Read AGENT_BOOT.md; register project name (Owen County Schools Upgrades & Athletics), number (3620251), the non-inheritance rule blocking UK CAER facts, the six-rank authority stack, and the required read order for the next agent.

nodes.name: Bind to Altitude Mesh OS doctrine
nodes.summary: Load DOCTRINE__ALTITUDE_MESH_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md; bind to the six-layer signal stack (Subatomic, Micro, Meso, Macro, VP/Exec Rollup, Founder), the Upward Reporting Law, the Upward-Wake Gate, and the cadence schedule that all Owen reports/orders must travel.

nodes.name: Enforce review-only posture and stop rules
nodes.summary: Adopt the stop-rule split from GATE_READINESS.md: agent may produce review and validation receipts unilaterally; live system touches, gate promotions, and live action packets require Michael's approval.

nodes.name: Enumerate Missing Source Evidence
nodes.summary: Read SOURCE_MAP.md Missing Source Evidence section: executed contract + NTP not read, live Sage not accessed (snapshot is March 2026), live Submittal Exchange not accessed, live Outlook not accessed, live OneDrive originals not re-inventoried, current May 2026 status unvalidated.

nodes.name: Pose the eight First Control Questions
nodes.summary: Pose: (1) executed contract value and latest revised contract; (2) which system controls submittals; (3) which system controls RFIs; (4) current schedule baseline and latest 3WLA; (5) which CO/CPR list is current; (6) open safety/QC/checklist exposure; (7) 14-day live work; (8) actions requiring Michael approval.

nodes.name: Resolve System-of-Record per lane
nodes.summary: Walk the SOURCE_MAP.md System-Of-Record Candidates table; for each lane (contract, cost/Sage, submittals, RFIs, schedule, safety/QC, correspondence, PM actions) decide which system is authoritative and downgrade conflicts to disputed pending reconciliation.

nodes.name: Verify live OneDrive path exists
nodes.summary: Step 1 of Next Safe Load Sequence: confirm '/Users/michael/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-DevereConstruction/03 Running Projects/2025/6. Owen Co Schools Upgrades & Athletics' is present on the target machine (confirmed live by operator on 2026-05-28).

nodes.name: Read latest cleanpoint and session handoff
nodes.summary: Step 2 of Next Safe Load Sequence: read the latest cleanpoint and latest session handoff from TCS_OVERLAY so the twin state is bound to the most recent committed snapshot before re-inventory.

nodes.name: Re-inventory original OneDrive controls
nodes.summary: Step 3 of Next Safe Load Sequence: walk folders 1-18 plus Issues, HERMES_INBOX, TCS_OVERLAY in the live OneDrive folder and produce a current control-document inventory (contract set, drawings, specs, RFIs, submittals, schedules, safety, QC).

nodes.name: Load dated evidence tokens against object families
nodes.summary: For each registered twin object family (Project, ProjectGate, ProjectTwinState, Zone, EvidenceToken, ApprovalBoundary, ActionRecord, RiskRecord) load EvidenceToken rows with source-path, fact-state, last-checked-date.

nodes.name: Advance OWEN-VQ-001..009 validation queue
nodes.summary: Reconcile each of the nine OWEN-VQ rows against live systems: submittal counts (VQ-001), RFI counts (VQ-002), overdue checklists (VQ-003), CO/CPR split (VQ-004), safety evidence (VQ-005), DPO reconciliation (VQ-006), schedule/3WLA freshness (VQ-007), PM transition correspondence (VQ-008), stale cleanpoints (VQ-009).

nodes.name: Post receipts under A0-D2 gate matrix
nodes.summary: For any gate movement, supply the GATE_READINESS.md receipt template (gate-id, prior-state, new-state, evidence-paths, fact-state, approver) and mark validation states using the canonical taxonomy (cited, inferred, validated, disputed, stale, superseded, not_authority).

nodes.name: Pull read-only Sage / Submittal Exchange / Outlook exports
nodes.summary: Step 4 of Next Safe Load Sequence: receive or pull read-only exports from Sage CM (current cost, COs, RFIs, submittals, daily logs, checklists), Submittal Exchange, and Outlook PM correspondence to replace the March 2026 packet snapshot.

nodes.name: Build first slices across required lanes
nodes.summary: Step 5 of Next Safe Load Sequence: build first slice for each lane (contract/gate, Sage/commercial, schedule, procurement, safety, quality, RFIs/submittals, PM rhythm) using the now-current exports and re-inventoried controls.

nodes.name: Mark every row with source/authority/fact-state/receipt path
nodes.summary: Step 6 of Next Safe Load Sequence: every slice row must carry source reference, authority level, fact state, human owner, approval requirement, last checked date, next action, and receipt path. This is the gate from Level 1 review-only shell to Level 2 operational twin.
